entries.value: "Shared helpers for the base-studio-code SQLite CLI+lib trio (plandb/skilldb/logs and their bsc-* binaries) — JSON value-list (de)serialization, home-dir resolution, JSON printing, and object-or-array stdin reads (#1621)."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.
# Lib only — no binaries. The hyphenated package name maps to the `bsc_sqlite_util` crate name.
sections.name: [build-dependencies]

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# `conn` pulls in rusqlite and the shared connection PLUMBING (open + busy_timeout, `:memory:`-aware
# string-error open, default-path resolver, JSON-blob row reads) for the SQLite STORES (plandb /
# skilldb / compliance / research). Off by default so the JSON-only consumers (e.g. the file-based
# `bsc-blueprint`) don't compile bundled SQLite they never use (#1863).
# Shared leaf utilities (#1646): the single source of truth for `home_dir` (re-exported below).
# Only under `conn`: `bundled` compiles SQLite from source (matches plandb/skilldb/compliance/research)
# for cross-platform reliability. Optional so default builds stay rusqlite-free.
